g.text: Completed learning paths, historical evidence, and planned external evaluations
(b) J0 / J1: shared adaptation with separate supervision units
J0: identity path + two heads. J1: copy J0 heads, then train adapter + heads.
(c) External RGB path and evaluation scope
Current RGB connection check: separate G0/G1/G2 heads after frozen J1; full event evaluation remains pending.
Solid paths above describe completed training. Dashed path describes external inference; it does not imply a completed benchmark.
MCFD: retain scenario groups across views. URFD: cam0 has both classes; cam1 is a positive-only diagnostic.
Offline pipeline: no claim of causal real-time operation. Recovery extensions are outside this benchmark figure.
